name: Cultivation
description: Ranks, sects, sacred items and a climb to power in a harsh world.

settingFields.label: Rank ladder
settingFields.hint: Lowest rank first. Characters pick their rank from this list.

settingFields.label: Major sects and factions
settingFields.hint: One per line, e.g. Azure Cloud Sect: a sword sect that guards the eastern pass.
default: Azure Cloud Sect: a proud sword sect on the highest peak, guarding the eastern pass.
Blood Lotus Valley: a demonic sect that trades in forbidden techniques.
The Lin Clan: an old family whose fortunes are fading.

settingFields.label: Difficulties faced by the main character
settingFields.default: Born with crippled meridians into a fading clan, the main character is mocked by peers, owed nothing by the sects, and hunted by an enemy who wants a secret they do not yet know they carry.

imageStyle: Chinese ink and colour wash painting: flowing ink lines, soft washes of colour, misty mountains and open space, like a classical xianxia illustration.
prompt: This is a cultivation (xianxia) novel. Power comes from cultivating through the ranks of the story's rank ladder; never skip ranks or invent ranks outside it.
Breakthroughs are earned through effort, insight, resources or risk, at the pace the setting's speed of power growth describes.
Sects, factions and the strong-eat-the-weak order of the world shape every encounter. Match the world cruelty and character mortality in the setting.
Name techniques and sacred items concretely and keep their limits consistent once established.
